verdict.rationale: Vestd documents cap table management, share issuance and data rooms for sharing files. Nothing in the evidence shows priced-round scenario modeling: no dilution calculation, option pool top-up, SAFE conversion or pro-forma ownership. Data-room sharing of cap tables and issuing actual shares are adjacent features, not round modeling, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can model a priced round — dilution, option pool top-up, SAFE conversion, pro-forma ownership — and share the scenario with counsel and investors
